E0102

Nothing named `pirnt` exists here

What

Nothing named `pirnt` exists here

Why

Only functions that have been defined (or built in, like `print` / `input`) can be called

Fix

Did you mean `print`?

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0102: tests/ui/channel_retired_forms.stderr.

Error [E0119]: there's no type called `Channel`
  --> tests/ui/channel_retired_forms.jet:3:25
    |
  3 | fn takes_channel(value: Channel<Int>) {}
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: generic types must name a struct or enum you defined
 Fix: check the spelling, or define the type first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0119]: `Channel` isn't generic
  --> tests/ui/channel_retired_forms.jet:3:25
    |
  3 | fn takes_channel(value: Channel<Int>) {}
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only types declared with type parameters accept `<…>`
 Fix: use `Channel` without type arguments
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0102]: `tasks.channel` is retired
  --> tests/ui/channel_retired_forms.jet:7:16
    |
  7 |     _ :: tasks.channel<Int>()
    |                ^^^^^^^
 Why: channels are a readable builtin and need no module import
 Fix: write `channel<T>()` or `channel<T>(capacity: 8)
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102

Error [E0102]: `Group.select()` is retired
  --> tests/ui/channel_retired_forms.jet:9:16
    |
  9 |         _ :: g.select()
    |                ^^^^^^
 Why: readiness waits are subjectless `if` tables on plain endpoints
 Fix: write `if { value, receiver -> handle(value) }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102
